description: Conspiracy-style infographic headed 'THE LORI KLAUSUTIS SCANDAL', styled as an expose MSNBC 'will not see'. It asks 'Where was Joe Scarborough at the time of death?', quotes a 'special report' claiming the Bergmanns arrived for an 8:00 AM appointment at then-Rep. Joe Scarborough's Fort Walton Beach office and found the body of aide Lori Klausutis, and lists three leading questions insinuating Scarborough's involvement. A press photograph shows police investigators carrying evidence bags from the office doorway, which bears a congressional seal. Klausutis's July 2001 death was officially ruled accidental (an undiagnosed heart condition caused a fall); the graphic's insinuation of foul play is unsubstantiated.
text: THE LORI KLAUSUTIS SCANDAL. THE SHOCKING TRUE STORY YOU WILL NOT SEE ON MSNBC. Where was Joe Scarborough at the time of death?. "A SHOCKING DISCOVERY. Juanita and Andreas Bergmann had an appointment at 8:00 AM, July 20th, at the Fort Walton Beach office of Congressman Joe Scarborough (R-FL). The appointment had been arranged by the Congressman's young aide, Lori Klausutis, and Mr. and Mrs. Bergmann thought they were going to meet with the Congressman to facilitate Mr. Bergmann's application for a green card. Instead, they found the body of Lori Klausutis.". FROM SPECIAL REPORT "NEVER BOUND BY THE TRUTH" BY CHRIS GEORGE AND DENIS WRIGHT. THE OBVIOUS QUESTIONS THAT NEED TO BE ANSWERED:. Where was Joe Scarborough when Lori Klausutis suffered her fatal injuries?. If he was in Washington DC as has been suggested, why would Lori Klausutis have scheduled an 8:00 AM appointment for him in Fort Walton Beach, Florida?. If he was in Florida and had no prior knowledge of Lori Klausutis's death, why didn't he show up for his 8:00 AM appointment with the Bergmanns?. Police investigators gather evidence from the Fort Walton Beach office of Congressman Joe Scarborough (R-FL) where 28-year-old intern Lori Klausutis was found dead July 20, 2001. #LORIKLAUSUTIS
flags: Insinuates foul play by Joe Scarborough; Klausutis's death was officially ruled accidental (heart condition causing a fall) and no evidence implicates Scarborough, who was reportedly in Washington DC
'Special report' authors and the Bergmann account are unverified claims carried as presented
Police investigators in the photo are unidentified individuals

description: Photograph of a printed copy of Susan Rice's declassified 'Note to File' email to herself, sent Fri 1/20/2017 12:15:32 PM (Inauguration Day), lying on a desk among other documents (a letter addressed to Sen. Charles Grassley, a law-firm letterhead page, a partially redacted 'EXHIBIT' page) with a yellow highlighter. The email, originally classified TOP SECRET (struck through), memorializes the January 5, 2017 Oval Office meeting with President Obama, FBI Director James Comey, DAG Sally Yates, and VP Biden about Russian election interference, Obama's 'by the book' instruction, and Comey's concerns about incoming NSA Flynn's contacts with Russian Ambassador Kislyak. A handwritten note beside a yellow bracket reads 'declassified paragraph'.
text: To: Rice, Susan E [REDACTED]. Cc: Ried, Curtis R. [REDACTED]. From: Rice, Susan E. Sent: Fri 1/20/2017 12:15:32 PM. Importance: Normal. Subject: Note to File [TOP SECRET (struck through), Record]. MAIL_RECEIVED: Fri 1/20/2017 12:15:33 PM. Classification: TOP SECRET (struck through). On January 5, following a briefing by IC leadership on Russian hacking during the 2016 Presidential election, President Obama had a brief follow-on conversation with FBI Director Jim Comey and Deputy Attorney General Sally Yates in the Oval Office. Vice President Biden and I were also present. President Obama began the conversation by stressing his continued commitment to ensuring that every aspect of this issue is handled by the Intelligence and law enforcement communities “by the book”. The President stressed that he is not asking about, initiating or instructing anything from a law enforcement perspective. He reiterated that our law enforcement team needs to proceed as it normally would by the book. From a national security perspective, however, President Obama said he wants to be sure that, as we engage with the incoming team, we are mindful to ascertain if there is any reason that we cannot share information fully as it relates to Russia. Director Comey affirmed that he is proceeding “by the book” as it relates to law enforcement. From a national security perspective, Comey said he does have some concerns that incoming NSA Flynn is speaking frequently with Russian Ambassador Kislyak. Comey said that could be an issue as it relates to sharing sensitive information. President Obama asked if Comey was saying that the NSC should not pass sensitive information related to Russia to Flynn. Comey replied “potentially.” He added that he has no indication thus far that Flynn has passed classified information to Kislyak, but he noted that “the level of communication is unusual.”. The President asked Comey to inform him if anything changes in the next few weeks that should affect how we share classified information with the incoming team. Comey said he would. [handwritten:] declassified paragraph. [surrounding papers, partially visible:] Honorable Charles E. Grassley, Chairman... Committee on the Judiciary... DC 20510... Dianne Feinste[in]... 555 Eleventh Street, N.W... Washington, D.C. 20004-130[4]... Tel: +1.202.637.2200 Fax: +1... www.lw.com. FIRM / AFFILIA[TE]... counsel, David... EXHIB[IT]... yak calls... 2016 calls... Yates... Brennan... at the Wh... assified... in Recen[t]... W88B61
orgs: Latham & Watkins (letterhead consistent with 555 Eleventh Street NW / lw.com)
flags: Law-firm identification from partial letterhead is probable, not certain
Surrounding documents are only partially visible and transcribed as fragments

description: Letterboxed two-photo collage in YouTube-thumbnail format (filename hqdefault.jpg). Left: a white-haired man in a navy blazer and khaki trousers photographed from behind on a European city street with Haussmann-style buildings, a 'P' parking sign, and parked bicycles, consistent with Paris. Right: an elderly man with a white beard and glasses in a tan suit standing near a glass door, photographed apparently candidly. No captions appear in the image itself; imagery of this type circulated with claims of a covert meeting sighting, but nothing in the image establishes who is shown.
flags: Left figure is seen only from behind and cannot be identified; the right man's identity cannot be confirmed from the image — no identification attempted
Paris location is inferred from architecture and signage, not shown
